capabilities: Edits Markdown notes in a formatted word-processor view
Formats text with ribbon toolbar and keyboard shortcuts
Edits tables in place with row, column, sort, and paste controls
Inserts and resizes images and manages properties as a form
Renders diagrams, equations, embeds, footnotes, and callouts
disambiguation: Not a Word document importer or exporter; it is an alternative editor that keeps notes as plain Markdown.
extras: No telemetry; network used only to load embedded web content. Mobile untested; Japanese and Korean translations unreviewed. Notes opt out via word-mode: false property or excluded folders. UI in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
problem: Obsidian's editor exposes raw Markdown syntax, which lacks the toolbar, in-place tables, and formatted view that word-processor users expect.

relations.evidence: Dataview queries and code blocks from other plugins are shown as their results.
If a note embeds a YouTube link, Word mode shows the YouTube player, which connects to youtube.com.

summary: Word-processor-style editor for Markdown notes with ribbon toolbar, in-place tables, images, and formatted view while files stay plain Markdown.
